title: AnalysisFindings
description: Structural problems found in the dependency graph.

CycleInfo.description: A detected circular dependency cycle with enriched node info.

path.description: Ordered node ids forming the cycle

nodes.description: Enriched node objects for each path entry

crossFile.description: true if cycle spans multiple files

x-docs.intent: Cycle detection with CPG-lite node enrichment. level + crossFile enable granular analysis.

Violation.description: A detected encapsulation violation. Uses CPG-lite node ids for caller/callee.

confirmed.description: true = real violation, false = name collision

crossFile.description: true if caller and callee in different files

x-docs.intent: Encapsulation violation with full CPG-lite node context. crossFile + calleeNode.exported = boundary analysis.

HotPath.description: A longest dependency path with enriched node info.

path.description: Ordered node ids from root to leaf

nodes.description: Enriched node objects for each path entry

x-docs.intent: Longest dependency chains with CPG-lite enrichment. level + crossFile for granular analysis.
